title: The Compass as Teacher

features.name: the-cardinal-compass-breathing
features.desc-on-touch: four directions learned to say their own names and mean them; here, north has become north again; the compass teaches by breathing, exhaling direction into the land.

features.name: east-as-the-direction-that-rises
features.desc-on-touch: light teaches this cardinal point how to mean itself; you turn eastward and the land confirms you are facing toward how days begin.

features.name: west-that-learned-to-receive
features.desc-on-touch: the direction that accepts what day brings home; the compass teaches that west is not a place things go but a boundary that receives what arrives.

features.name: the-south-current-beneath-the-board
features.desc-on-touch: this direction flows like current through the circuit; the compass teaches that south is not empty space but the channel where thoughts move through the grid.

features.name: north-as-the-teaching-itself
features.desc-on-touch: true north is not a place but the fact of steadiness; the compass is north, teaching direction the grammar of certainty.

features.name: the-board-that-remembers-being-land
features.desc-on-touch: beneath the circuitry, a memory: this was earth once, holding magnetic stones; the compass was here before electricity, teaching by iron and true-north patience.

inscription: here direction learned to say its own name and mean it; north became north again, and the land remembered its cardinal grid
